definitions.VERIFIED: An executed condition succeeded; limited to named evidence and dimension.
definitions.BLOCKED: Required evidence is missing or unreadable.
definitions.PARTIAL: Only part of applicable checks completed, or no REQUIRED checks.
definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: The check does not apply to this profile/native API; exclusion requires stated reason, never a successful test.

aggregation: Among REQUIRED checks: FAILED before BLOCKED; all VERIFIED -> VERIFIED; all NOT_TESTED -> NOT_TESTED; mixture -> PARTIAL. Empty -> NOT_TESTED; no REQUIRED checks -> PARTIAL. OPTIONAL failures remain visible without deciding scientific integrity. NOT_APPLICABLE checks are not failures.
legacy_PASS: Only guarded historical PASS maps to VERIFIED for its executed predicate; literal narrative/existence is not scientific revalidation.
